args.text: When a process description specifies an activity's actor, action, object, recipient, or direction of transfer, label the corresponding BPMN activity to preserve those details and avoid changing the described meaning.

trace.reason: Check whether an existing learned guideline already covers faithful activity labels.

result.rule: When the description states an activity or outcome and identifies its action, object, actor, or recipient: label the corresponding BPMN element with concise wording that preserves those stated details and does not substitute a different action or meaning

When the description explicitly names multiple operations or specifies an activity’s object or recipient: Retain those stated details in the corresponding BPMN activity label so the label does not broaden or narrow the described work.

When the description names a distinct activity or outcome and states its action or completion condition: Label the corresponding BPMN element with the described action or outcome. Do not replace it with a broader or narrower action, or add detail the description does not support.
When the description states the purpose or destination of an activity: Include that stated purpose or destination in the BPMN activity label, rather than labeling only the broader action.

args.text: the description specifies the action and direction of a transfer or exchange as performed or experienced by a participant. Label the corresponding BPMN activity to preserve the described direction and role, rather than switching sender and receiver or changing the action.
